project_info.theme: Executive quote card from Global Dairy Congress 2026
project_info.color_palette: Purple, white, black, soft conference beige, floral accent colors

main_subject.detail: A real conference photo of a middle-aged Asian male executive speaking at a lectern with a microphone. The podium front reads 'GLOBAL DAIRY CONGRESS 2026' and 'Fit for purpose'. Lower-left text identifies him as 'Ông Nguyễn Quang Trí' and 'Giám đốc Điều hành khối Marketing'. A long quotation reads 'Vinamilk Optimum A2 Pro+ được ra đời nhằm nâng cao chuẩn dinh dưỡng cho trẻ em Việt, dựa trên nền tảng khoa học thực chứng và nguồn cảm hứng từ dưỡng chất “vàng” trong sữa Mẹ.'
main_subject.style: Editorial conference portrait adapted into branded quote-card social creative

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square quote-card social poster for a Vinamilk executive statement at Global Dairy Congress 2026. Centerpiece is a photoreal conference photo of a middle-aged Asian male executive speaking at a purple lectern with the exact visible podium text 'GLOBAL DAIRY CONGRESS 2026' and 'Fit for purpose'. Include the exact lower-left text 'Ông Nguyễn Quang Trí', 'Giám đốc Điều hành khối Marketing', and the full quote 'Vinamilk Optimum A2 Pro+ được ra đời nhằm nâng cao chuẩn dinh dưỡng cho trẻ em Việt, dựa trên nền tảng khoa học thực chứng và nguồn cảm hứng từ dưỡng chất “vàng” trong sữa Mẹ.'. Background is a softly blurred conference stage. Surrounding elements: microphone arm, podium, white text overlays, and a floral corner illustration. Technical style: photoreal event photography with branded editorial overlay, soft indoor conference lighting, shallow depth of field and gentle stage highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
